topography.project_purpose: WOOFi is a multichain decentralized exchange and trade-and-earn platform offering spot swaps, cross-chain swaps and routing, staking, and single-sided yield products.
topography.relationship_narrative: Both families share cross-chain infrastructure via AutoFarmV2_CrossChain and proxy patterns like TransparentUpgradeableProxy. WOOFi Swap provides liquidity and token infrastructure that may be utilized by WooFi Pro Perps for settlement or collateral.
